Rohan —

We can support a one-time invoice-only setup for pilots but will require:
1) Completed PO-Exception-Request-Form (I attached a blank template).
2) A spend cap (recommended $10k) and expiration date (we usually set 45 days).
3) PO-exception approvals from Procurement Lead and Finance (cc'ing Priyom).
4) Helix to be onboarded as an "invoice-only" vendor code; payments will be subject to Net30 once invoices are received and matched to the approved SOW.

Risks/notes:
- We must confirm SOC 2 or compensating controls if Helix will process any customer data. If not, we can proceed with standard legal terms.
- If this pilot extends beyond the cap or becomes recurring, we will require a standard PO and vendor setup.

Priyom — can you confirm Finance's threshold for approving invoice-only vendors and whether we need a PO number for internal tracking?

Thanks,
